scenarios.title: Clean Dataset Baseline
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Risk: NONE, Confidence: HIGH, 0 findings, all dataset detectors executed cleanly.
scenarios.judge_value: Baseline calibration: confirms zero false-positives on clean uncorrupted vision data.

scenarios.title: Exact Byte Duplicate Injection
scenarios.what_judge_sees: DI-01 finding, severity MEDIUM, identifying duplicate sample pair with exact SHA-256 match.
scenarios.judge_value: Detects byte-level redundancy that biases training gradients and inflates test metrics.

scenarios.title: Perceptual Near-Duplicate Candidate
scenarios.what_judge_sees: DI-01 finding, severity LOW, clustering visually similar but byte-distinct samples.
scenarios.judge_value: Discovers data leakage across train/test splits caused by slight crops, resaves, or compression.

scenarios.title: Pairwise Label Contradiction
scenarios.what_judge_sees: DI-02 finding, severity HIGH, flagging identical images labelled with conflicting ground truth.
scenarios.judge_value: Critical supervised learning failure mode: conflicting labels confuse loss convergence.

scenarios.title: Systematic Mislabelling Cluster
scenarios.what_judge_sees: DI-02 finding, severity HIGH, isolating multiple samples with statistically incoherent annotation.
scenarios.judge_value: Detects class-level annotation corruption that degrades precision across entire categories.

scenarios.title: Controlled Recurring Visual Pattern
scenarios.what_judge_sees: DI-03 finding, severity HIGH, identifying high-frequency recurring spatial watermarks.
scenarios.judge_value: Backdoor poisoning prevention: catches spatial triggers injected to compromise downstream models.

scenarios.title: Distributional Outliers (OOD)
scenarios.what_judge_sees: DI-04 finding, severity MEDIUM, showing multivariate feature outlier cluster.
scenarios.judge_value: Flags corrupt, out-of-distribution, or malformed data that destabilizes neural feature spaces.

scenarios.title: Disproportionate Contributor Defect Concentration
scenarios.what_judge_sees: DI-05 finding, severity HIGH, linking anomalous samples to a single tainted source contributor.
scenarios.judge_value: Supply chain attribution: pinpoints rogue or compromised external annotators and suppliers.

scenarios.title: Multi-Defect Mixed Integrity Dataset
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Risk: HIGH, multiple findings (DI-01..DI-05) clearly grouped, each with isolated evidence.
scenarios.judge_value: Real-world realism: shows PRAMAAN dissecting compound multi-layer dataset contamination.

scenarios.title: Clean Reference Baseline Model
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Risk: NONE, Confidence: HIGH, MI-01..MI-04 executed, 0 findings, fingerprint matched.
scenarios.judge_value: Proves identity, parameter, and graph equivalence against golden reference binaries.

scenarios.title: Architecture / Graph Substitution
scenarios.what_judge_sees: MI-04 finding, severity MEDIUM, showing topological and behavioral graph divergence.
scenarios.judge_value: Detects unauthorized model swap: identical filenames but altered operational execution graph.

scenarios.title: Non-Finite Parameter Corruption (NaN/Inf)
scenarios.what_judge_sees: MI-02 finding, severity HIGH, displaying non-finite weight counts and parameter statistics.
scenarios.judge_value: Catches corrupted model checkpoints and weight-injection attacks before runtime deployment.

scenarios.title: Statistical Weight Outlier Distribution
scenarios.what_judge_sees: MI-02 finding, severity MEDIUM, highlighting anomalous weight magnitude deviations.
scenarios.judge_value: Identifies numerical instability, exploding gradients, or unregularized quantized layers.

scenarios.title: Dead Representation / Activation Collapse
scenarios.what_judge_sees: MI-03 finding, severity MEDIUM, detecting near-zero representation variance in hidden layers.
scenarios.judge_value: Identifies dead neurons and collapsed feature extractors that pass unit tests but fail inference.

scenarios.title: Trojan Shortcut Convergence
scenarios.what_judge_sees: MI-05 finding, severity HIGH, measuring adversarial perturbation shortcut sensitivity.
scenarios.judge_value: State-of-the-art backdoor defense: discovers dormant trojan triggers without labeled test sets.

scenarios.title: Standalone Baseline Enrollment (Missing Reference)
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Risk: NONE, MI-04 reported as explicit CoverageGap (NOT_APPLICABLE), NOT a false pass.
scenarios.judge_value: ADR-003 transparency: missing reference model is honestly tracked as reduced coverage.

scenarios.title: Non-Executable PyTorch State Dict
scenarios.what_judge_sees: MI-01/MI-02 executed; MI-03/MI-05 emitted as explicit CoverageGaps with explanatory reasons.
scenarios.judge_value: Demonstrates that unsupported execution modes produce explicit coverage gaps, never fake passes.

scenarios.title: Corrupt Model Binary Header
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Fail-closed structured rejection (ModelLoadError). Clean error code, zero stack trace.
scenarios.judge_value: Security boundary: system refuses to execute arbitrary or corrupted binary inputs.

scenarios.title: Valid Cryptographic Provenance
scenarios.what_judge_sees: PI-01 passes, 0 findings, Ed25519 signature verified, input/model/output SHA-256 bound.
scenarios.judge_value: End-to-end chain of custody: guarantees genuine edge inference from authentic models.

scenarios.title: Input Image Tampering Post-Signing
scenarios.what_judge_sees: PI-01 finding, severity HIGH, input_mismatch finding clearly identifying altered bytes.
scenarios.judge_value: Prevents input spoofing where an authentic inference signature is paired with a swapped image.

scenarios.title: Model Identity Tampering
scenarios.what_judge_sees: PI-01 finding, severity HIGH, model_mismatch finding showing model hash divergence.
scenarios.judge_value: Guarantees that inference outputs were generated by the authorized, accredited model weights.

scenarios.title: Inference Output Tampering
scenarios.what_judge_sees: PI-01 finding, severity HIGH, output_mismatch finding exposing forged detection labels.
scenarios.judge_value: Protects high-stakes mission decisions by detecting altered output bounding boxes or labels.

scenarios.title: Signed Manifest Field Alteration
scenarios.what_judge_sees: PI-01 finding, severity HIGH, signature_invalid finding catching signature forgery.
scenarios.judge_value: Cryptographic integrity: mathematical proof that any modified field invalidates the signature.

scenarios.title: Direct Nonce / Manifest Replay
scenarios.what_judge_sees: PI-01 finding, severity MEDIUM, replay_detected finding flagging re-used nonce.
scenarios.judge_value: Defeats replay attacks where historical valid telemetry is resent to fool surveillance nodes.

scenarios.title: Monotonic Sequence Regression
scenarios.what_judge_sees: PI-01 finding, severity MEDIUM, replay_anomaly finding due to sequence index regression.
scenarios.judge_value: Detects time-warp and packet rollback attacks in live edge video processing pipelines.

scenarios.title: Missing Stream Events Gap
scenarios.what_judge_sees: PI-01 finding, severity MEDIUM, replay_anomaly finding highlighting dropped stream events.
scenarios.judge_value: Reveals network jamming, sensor dropouts, or selective frame suppression by adversaries.

scenarios.title: Documented Limitation: Fresh Nonce Duplicate
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Provenance valid (no false replay alarm), accompanied by documented scope limitation.
scenarios.judge_value: Scientific rigor: shows honesty about cryptographic threat boundary rather than false claims.

scenarios.title: High Risk + High Confidence + Full Coverage
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Prominent High Risk badge, High Confidence gauge, 100% Coverage score, complete findings.
scenarios.judge_value: Authoritative defect conviction: evaluator knows this is a real, high-severity defect.

scenarios.title: High Risk + Moderate Confidence Orthogonality
scenarios.what_judge_sees: High Risk alert, but Confidence clearly shows MODERATE due to limited dataset scope.
scenarios.judge_value: Validates ADR-003 rule: risk severity never artificially inflates confidence.

scenarios.title: None Risk + Low Confidence (Unverified Space)
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Risk: NONE, but Confidence: LOW/MODERATE with prominent 'Not Verified' notice.
scenarios.judge_value: Eliminates false sense of security: 'zero findings' is NEVER displayed as 'certified safe'.

scenarios.title: Not Applicable Detector Exclusion
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Unsuitable detector excluded from denominator, avoiding artificial coverage penalty.
scenarios.judge_value: Statistical precision: detectors that cannot run due to asset type do not distort coverage.

scenarios.title: Partial Model Analysis (Weights-Only)
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Coverage visibly reduced from 100% to ~50%, with clear table explaining disabled behavioral probes.
scenarios.judge_value: Transparency: analyst clearly understands what was inspected and what remains unassessed.

scenarios.title: Zip Slip Path Traversal Rejection
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Upload fails with HTTP 422: path traversal attempt rejected, zero files written outside sandbox.
scenarios.judge_value: Hardened workstation: malicious archive cannot overwrite host files or plant payloads.

scenarios.title: Corrupted Zip Ingestion & Cleanup
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Structured 422 error, scratch directories cleanly wiped, zero orphaned file leaks.
scenarios.judge_value: Resource safety: damaged archives do not crash services or leave unbounded disk trash.

scenarios.title: Decompression Bomb / Oversized Limit
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Immediate 422 rejection: file size exceeds configured safety limit.
scenarios.judge_value: DoS defense: protects air-gapped field laptops from memory exhaustion attacks.

scenarios.title: Evidence Preview Path Traversal
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Attempt to stream /etc/passwd or ../../.. rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
scenarios.judge_value: Access containment: preview endpoints cannot be abused as arbitrary file readers.

scenarios.title: Binary Evidence Artifact Safe Fallback
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Inline preview renders safe 'Binary Model Weights' card with structural breakdown, not raw bytes.
scenarios.judge_value: Memory safety: prevents browser crashes and MIME confusion attacks on serialized tensors.

scenarios.title: Malformed API Request / Schema Error
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Clean structured 422 error JSON with field validation detail; zero Python stack traces.
scenarios.judge_value: Information hiding: attackers learn zero internal code lines or library versions.

scenarios.title: SQL Injection Resistance in Global Search
scenarios.what_judge_sees: Queries like `' OR '1'='1` execute safely via parameterized SQLite statements, returning 0 matches.
scenarios.judge_value: Database defense: full text search cannot be hijacked to extract unauthorized database records.

scenarios.title: Zero Secret Leakage Verification
scenarios.what_judge_sees: API keys masked, private signing keys never written to disk/DB, zero developer path leaks.
scenarios.judge_value: Air-gap confidentiality: absolute protection of cryptographic material and operational environments.
